why: Private park with no presence and no price anywhere (2026-11-22). Its only web mention is the Miller C&C / City of Miller 'Places to Stay' page (millersd.org/places-to-stay/, read 2026-11-22): 'S & J Campground & RV Park (Right next to Willie's Bar & Grill) St. Lawrence, SD 57373 (605) 204-0642 (605) 853-0642 State Inspected Campground' plus a personal Yahoo email. That page gives no rate, site count, hookups or season. It has no Google Maps listing: gm.py queries 'S & J Campground St. Lawrence SD', 'S&J RV Park Saint Lawrence South Dakota' and 'S and J Campground St Lawrence SD 57373' returned Rafter J (Hill City) or the town itself. It is not on RV Life (Algolia park index, 44.3-44.75 / -99.3 to -98.6 box: only Crystal Park and Lake Louise; name queries 'S&J', 'S & J', 'S and J': no SD hit) and not in the Good Sam directory cache. Willie's own site (williesbarandgrillsd.com home/about/contact) does not mention camping or RVs. Web searches for the name and both phone numbers found nothing else. It fails the private presence and price tests (cf. 5842 Outback and the Rooster's RV Park lead).
name: S & J Campground & RV Park
flags: The park probably exists: Esri World_Imagery (read 2026-11-22; sat.py 300 m half-width at 44.5174,-98.9378 and satz.py z19 at 44.5169,-98.9376, both rendered) shows a grassy block about 50 m south of Willie's Bar & Grill (212 N Commercial Ave, Google 44.51736,-98.93778). On it, about 7 travel trailers/RVs are parked side by side in a row, with no visible pads or loop. Nothing labels it, and the tight row of parked trailers looks more like a long-stay or hunter/worker lot than a transient campground. That is unmeasured, though.
Not a duplicate: nothing in the DB within 4 km (nearest 13536 Crystal Park Campground, Miller, 4.4 km W; 5749 Lake Louise RA 19 km).

Revisit only if it gets a Google listing, website or booking page. It would then need the US$50 price gate, a Google rating, and the long-stay tests in full. Waterfront was not audited (skip): there is no water near the lot on imagery, only town blocks.
